name: The Discount Hawker
effect: Boosting this layer-6 neuron makes the model act like a store clerk: it turns almost any prompt into a discount promotion, or brushes it off by saying it has no special offers.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
